title: docs(mcp): document hosted worker deploy pipeline
author: karanray06
pr_body_excerpt:
Record how the MCP Cloudflare Worker at mcp.pollinations.ai deploys:

- deploy-applications.yml triggers on production branch pushes
- discover.cjs matches apps/mcp via deploy.json watch globs
- Path filters cover both apps/** and packages/mcp/
- Production gating via guard-production-source.yml
- No staging MCP deploy (thin proxy; staging at gateway level)

Fixes #13408

gist.headline: The worker's flight plan
gist.blurb: The MCP worker deployment path is now written down, including the bits that decide when it gets to leave the hive.
gist.summary: Documented the mcp.pollinations.ai Cloudflare Worker production deploy pipeline: deploy-applications.yml detects apps/mcp through deploy.json watch globs, watches apps/** and packages/mcp/, and passes production-source gating.
gist.impact: Contributors can now trace exactly how MCP changes reach production and why the thin proxy has no separate staging deployment.
gist.visual_concept: Polli acts as a careful release engineer in a cozy garden workshop, following a glowing map from an MCP code-plant to a small Cloudflare-style worker tower. A CRT monitor robot holds a deploy checklist while paths marked apps/mcp and packages/mcp merge at a production gate; flowers and vines make the pipeline feel documented rather than mysterious.
